name: atlas-visual
description: Visual validation platform foundation for QA teams.

scripts.validate: npm run build && node dist/src/index.js validate
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test $(find dist/tests -maxdepth 1 -name '*.test.js' ! -name '*.integration.test.js' | sort | tr '\n' ' ')
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && ATLAS_RUN_INTEGRATION=true node --test dist/tests/**/*.integration.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && ATLAS_RUN_INTEGRATION=true c8 node --test dist/tests/**/*.test.js
